description: This file defines the UndeployedRelationships class, which manages uninstalled or undeployed module relationships in the SuiteCRM system. It handles loading, saving, building, and manipulating relationships, including integrating them into layouts and module definitions.

classes.name: UndeployedRelationships
classes.description: A class that manages undeployed module relationships in SuiteCRM, providing functionality for loading, saving, building, and modifying relationships, especially in the context of module packaging and deployment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with the module's base path and loads saved relationships.

methods.name: findRelatableModules
methods.description: Finds all modules, including undeployed, that can participate in relationships.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship to the undeployed relationships set and updates layouts accordingly.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a relationship by name and updates layouts.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads saved relationship definitions for the module.

methods.name: _updateRelationshipDefinition
methods.description: Updates legacy relationship definitions to the current format.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves all relationships relevant to undeployed modules, including those from ModuleBuilder packages.

methods.name: enforceRelationshipOnly
methods.description: Flags relationships that only require a non-UI representation due to compatibility issues.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds relationship files and configuration for deployment, handling activities relationship expansion.

methods.name: addInstallDefs
methods.description: Adds this module's relationship install definitions to a provided set.

methods.name: addFieldsToUndeployedLayouts
methods.description: Adds relationship fields to layouts of undeployed modules.

methods.name: removeFieldsFromUndeployedLayouts
methods.description: Removes relationship fields from layouts of undeployed modules.

methods.name: removeAppLangStrings
methods.description: Removes related language strings for activities relationships.

methods.name: updateUndeployedLayout
methods.description: Adds or removes relationship fields from module layouts based on relationship definitions.

methods.name: saveFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Adds relationship fields to deployed module layouts.
